nom: NUXE Very Rose Face Toner with Rose Water for Sensitive Skin, 6.7 Fl Oz

avis.texte: Refreshing, yes. Scent is hard to handle. If it were straight rose. It would be lovely. To me it has a chemical old hair spray scent. Will keep but need to hold my breath when I use. Too bad because I love this brand and have so many of their other products. Will not repurchase.
Smells heavenly, does what one expects a toner to do! Will definitely purchase again!
My wife loves this toner. It is non irritating and soothing, yet doesn't clog the pores!
The bottle seemed to have break during delivery so there was nothing inside to give this a try.. Hopefully they change their bottle and make it more sturdy.

avis.titre: Great toner amongst other great products from NUXE
avis.texte: Great product line from France that is plant based, and very reasonably priced!
La rose toujours! Un bonheur, une fraicheur inegalee. Je prefere ceoendant le transferer ds un recipient muni de spray pour l'esperger sur mon visage
J aurais voulu un spray mais c est bien sur un.coton laisse la peau nette

This facial mist is a game changer! A quick spritz after a busy day, instantly feels revitalizing. It’s lovely for a midday pick-me-up. The scent is beautifully subtle, though those sensitive to fragrance might find it a bit strong.

avis.titre: Missing misting spray top, but refreshing and hydrating
avis.texte: Mine did not come with a misting bottle as specified, so I apply this to a cotton pad first, then wipe down my face after washing. Smells of sweet fresh cut roses which I do admit was overpowering at first, but has grown on me with more uses. I prefer unscented products on my face because I tend to have a sensitive nose and eyes, but fortunately I do at least like this scent and the scent did fade away quick enough as to not irritate me- just would prefer it in a perfume or body spray instead! I think I was expecting a lighter rose scent as it was called "rose water" but now that I think about it, rose water extract in baking is pretty powerful in small doses so it can be strong for the unprepared. The scent aside, this toner does feel luxurious on the skin and was able to remove remnants of makeup that my face wash left behind. My skin felt hydrated and more smooth than when using my old witch hazel toner. I've been using it multiple times now, and so far my aging sensitive combo skin is loving it and has had no breakouts. Only wish it had the misting top because I think it would make it more fun to use. Love that it's vegan and more nature-focused.

This toner cleaned my skin well, left it feeling smooth and did not cause any irritation, although the scent is extremely overpowering. I felt as though I applied perfume directly onto my face. I wish the scent was more mild and/or they simply allowed the rose extract to provide the scent. Maybe the other ingredients needed a stronger cover scent. Either way, the scent is too overpowering for me.

avis.titre: I keep this rose floral water in the fridge for extra cooling effects on hot days!
avis.texte: NUXE Very Rose Refreshing Toning Mist. Facial Spray Toner (rose floral water) has helped my skin feel hydrated, soft and calm plus no irritation! But the bottle doesn’t have a spray mister despite the name. So I to apply it using a cotton pad and it gives me more control over how much I use. The subtle rose scent is fresh and delicate and clear bottle design is nice. it looks elegant on my vanity and I can easily see how much is left. If I compare it with other premium brands Ive used in the past, I’d say, Guerlain’s Essence of Radiance Toner had a more luxurious feel but was heavy for my sensitive skin whereas NUXE’s lightweight formula with rose floral water soothes without residue! It helps remove any impurities and leaves my face feeling refreshed everytime I use it. I love that it’s a vegan formula made in France. it feels like a little luxury every day. I keep it in the fridge for an extra cooling effect on hot days!

I am a huge Nuxe fan and this is my first go at using one of their toners. Unfortunately the cap was cracked and the nozzle stopper also cracked off the lid. I had to use tweezers to unplug the hole. I resourcefully used a hydrocolloid bandaid to keep the lid shut but I just can't shake the bottle (habit) as it will leak out of the side crack. Now, the toner itself is a beautiful rose aroma and because I am taking the bottle and tilting it to get the toner onto my cotton pad, I often use too much. My face feels nice and well prepped for the rest of my skincare. I should also mention that I was expecting some sort of misting apparatus but I think that was never the case according to the photos.

The scent is amazing, like of like Ralph Lauren romance or a Clinique fragrance. The ingredients are pretty simple. It states on the bottle that it perfects makeup removal so I’m not sure if that means it helps with removing or not. The pour spout is a bit annoying because of how it comes out, it wastes a lot. It does seem hydrating though and felt refreshing on my skin. I do like the smell of it
